approval_behavior: Approval records are grouped as pending/approved/denied; actors cannot approve their own authority expansion.
assignment_behavior: Worker/resident assignments are loaded and persisted through runtime/ai_services/model_assignments.json with Steward-only writes.
audit_rediscovery_behavior: Audit tail is newest-first and sanitized; UI exposes rediscover, status, models, registry, state, audit, and approval command hooks.
filesystem_model_discovery_behavior: Enumerates declared service model directories, including GGUF/model files and HuggingFace-style or repository-like directories; loaded models are marked separately from installed inventory.
known_limitations: Static HTML cannot execute local commands directly; it renders copyable local command hooks.
Filesystem discovery can only enumerate model directories visible to the local host running the generator.
preference_behavior: Estate defaults are loaded from runtime/ai_services/model_preferences.json with unresolved markers for unknown references.
recommended_next_action: Chief Architect review and Steward browser verification of the AI Services / Models workspace.
